# Village of North Troy municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 17; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 253 (Village of North Troy): section 5 provides for a Moderator elected at the annual meeting
Village of North Troy, Annual Village Meeting Minutes, March 17, 2026: Helene Croteau was nominated and elected Moderator by voice vote

offices.title: Village Trustee
offices.org_name: Village of North Troy Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 253 (Village of North Troy): section 5 provides for three trustees on staggered three-year terms, one elected each year
Village of North Troy, Board of Trustees page (troyvt.gov): lists Terri Medley (Chair), Holly Ross, and Helene Croteau as the village trustees
Village of North Troy, Annual Village Meeting Minutes, March 17, 2026: Terri Medley was re-elected trustee for a three-year term

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Village of North Troy Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 253 (Village of North Troy): section 5 provides for a Collector of Taxes elected at the annual meeting; village practice styles the office Delinquent Tax Collector
Village of North Troy, Annual Village Meeting Minutes, March 17, 2026: April Descheneau was elected Delinquent Tax Collector
Village of North Troy, Village Office page (troyvt.gov): lists April Descheneau as Delinquent Tax Collector
